name: hackmatch
description: Smart Hackathon Team Builder Platform — Full-Stack Real-Time Application

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix client
